# Swoonflicks

> Romance novels, now on screen: English short dramas to binge.

Complete text of all guides, frequently asked questions, invitation code instructions, and drama catalog.

## Dramas

- [Wedding Secret Broke Us](https://swoonflicks.com/wedding-secret-broke-us/): On her wedding night, Tessa discovers her husband Westley cheated with her three best-friends and learns he is the mastermind behind the ruin of her life and her parents’ death. The friends plot against her and goad Westley into hurting her.
- [The Triplets' Final Regret](https://swoonflicks.com/the-triplets-final-regret/): Elisa, a half-human, half-vampire girl, believes the Lockhart triplets are the only people in the world she can truly trust. She wants to become human for them—and spend forever with one of them. But everything changes when Amber, the maid’s daughter, appears. Again and again, Elisa is abandoned, humiliated, and stripped of her dignity. All for Amber. Finally, she decides to let go and accept her fate: leaving day school behind, transferring to night school, and becoming a vampire. But when Elisa appears in her night school uniform, held in the arms of a powerful vampire heir, why do the triplets who once threw her away suddenly fall into regret and panic—kneeling before her, begging for forgiveness?
- [Claimed by My Ex-Boyfriend's Mafia Uncle](https://swoonflicks.com/claimed-by-my-ex-boyfriend-s-mafia-uncle/): Lily, once humiliated by her arrogant ex, Jasper, unexpectedly marries his powerful, ruthless godfather, Maddox. At the family gathering, Maddox forces Jasper to call her aunt. Old humiliation resurfaces, leaving Lily stunned. Little does she know, Jasper's obsession has only just begun, and a deadly secret threatens to destroy this dangerous new marriage.
- [Cowboys on Mars](https://swoonflicks.com/cowboys-on-mars/): On Mars, we don't ranch cattle or harvest corn. We mine subsurface ice veins. And there's no bigger rancher on planet than Wyatt Andros. But when Wyatt's brother Kane double crosses him, and leaves him for dead, everything is taken from him. It's only because of the kindness of fellow rancher Emma that Wyatt survives, thinking she's taking in a lowly miner. Years later, keeping his identity a secret and protecting his wife and daughter becomes the only way for Wyatt to plot revenge against the brother who wronged him... and get his ranching empire back on the dusty red planet.
- [My Wife's Secret "Daddy"](https://swoonflicks.com/my-wife-s-secret-daddy/): Delivery driver Ian suspects his wife Lina is having an affair behind his back. He notices one red flag after another, but each time, Lina talks her way out of it just enough to make him second-guess himself. How long can her lies hold up before the truth finally catches up with her?
- [My Billionaire Boss Won't Let Me Quit](https://swoonflicks.com/my-billionaire-boss-wont-let-me-quit/): Seeking a fresh start after years of managing crises, Grace takes on a new job, only to be swept into a fake marriage by her enigmatic boss, Mason. As their pretend arrangement blurs into undeniable passion, Grace falls deeper into his spell. But Mason is playing a far more dangerous game—and he has no intention of ever letting her go.
- [Rejected Luna Is the Alpha Queen](https://swoonflicks.com/rejected-luna-is-the-alpha-queen/): After her Moonshadow Pack was slaughtered by rogues, Arya, the werewolf warrior, hides her immense power to honor her mother's dying wish. She marries Alpha Micah, and hides her strength. But then, Alpha Micah breaks his vows and returns from war with a new mate, Vera, and demands that Arya share her Luna title with her. Faced with Vera, Micah, and his family's cruelty, Arya can no longer bear it. She leaves Micah and unleashes the immense power of the White Wolf, reclaiming what is hers with the help of Lowe, the Lycan King. After separating from Micah, Arya discovers that Vera not only stole Micah from her, but is also the traitor who slaughtered her parents and the Moonshadow Pack. Arya rushes to the battlefield to face her betrayers, and in the process, finds love in Lowe, the Lycan King.
- [The Empress's Final Wish](https://swoonflicks.com/the-empresss-final-wish/): On her deathbed, Empress Rosa clings to life over an unfulfilled wish, while her three sons ruthlessly vie for the throne. Meanwhile, Celeste arrives to help the Empress. Dismissed by the skeptical princes, Celeste enters the palace, where the dying Empress miraculously revives, kneels, and addresses her as her lady...
- [Betrayed at My Engagement, I Wed the Billionaire Who'd Secretly Loved Me](https://swoonflicks.com/betrayed-at-my-engagement-i-wed-the-billionaire-wh/): Evelyn Sterling, heiress and gifted jewelry designer, gave eight years to fiancé Adrian Whitmore—hiding her brilliance to keep the peace. On their engagement night, he abandoned her to celebrate Lydia Carter, the horse trainer’s daughter, even moving Lydia into their home. Adrian stole “Heart of Eternity,” the final masterpiece left by Evelyn’s late mother, and let Lydia enter it under her own name. He then forced Evelyn to confess plagiarism, destroying her reputation. Heartbroken, Evelyn breaks the engagement and accepts an arranged marriage to banking heir Sebastian Kingsley. Adrian soon learns his empire and life were held together by Evelyn. Lydia’s lies and theft unravel, and Adrian discovers Evelyn—not Lydia—saved his life eight years ago. Evelyn returns as Mrs. Kingsley, reclaims her designs and reputation, builds her own brand, and finally opens her heart to Sebastian, who has secretly loved her all along.
- [My Billion Dollar Waiter](https://swoonflicks.com/my-billion-dollar-waiter/): So casual! He casually had an affair with my stepsister, and I casually found a waiter to marry him. An untoward heiress found out her fiancé is cheating with her stepsister at her wedding day. Provoked by her father and stepsister, she proceeds with the wedding and marries the waiter of the hotel on site. She couldn’t possible imagine, the waiter is actually the CEO of a top global corporation…
- [I Married a Poor Bodyguard, Only to Discover He’s a Billionaire CEO](https://swoonflicks.com/i-married-a-poor-bodyguard-only-to-discover-he-s-a/): To save the foster home, Harper must raise $180,000 within 48 hours, only to unexpectedly enter a flash marriage with Declan, a "poor bodyguard." She has no idea that he is actually the CEO of a billion-dollar empire. As plagiarism schemes, a wealthy love rival, and lies about his identity threaten their contract marriage, Declan ultimately proves his love by risking everything for her.
- [Bound by His Fire at the Magic Academy](https://swoonflicks.com/bound-by-his-fire-at-the-magic-academy/): When powerless Stillblood Elara Calder is unexpectedly accepted to elite Asterfell Academy, she accidentally steals the deadly violet fire of its most feared heir, Jace Blackwood. Now their magic—and their bodies—are dangerously bound. Forced to work together in secret before the fire kills him, Elara and Jace discover the one thing even more dangerous than their curse: wanting each other.
- [Fierce Grace: Braving the Betrayal（DUBBED）](https://swoonflicks.com/fierce-grace-braving-the-betrayal-dubbed/): For the sake of her boyfriend, Kyle Jensen, Myla Young sacrifices her studies and pursues a career abroad. She founds Rosa Corp, which rapidly ascends to become the world's leading company within seven years. Secretly supporting Kyle's education, she ensures his success, even securing him a position at Foster Corp in Osian. However, upon her return to reveal the truth and propose to Kyle, he publicly ends their relationship to pursue another wealthy woman.
- [Rejecting My Five Female Mates](https://swoonflicks.com/rejecting-my-five-female-mates/): Orphaned Caine spent ten years protecting his foster father Alpha's five daughters, believing they were his destined mates. However, the arrival of Seth, a manipulative rogue wolf, shatters his world. Blinded by Seth's deceit, the five sisters turn against Caine, relentlessly humiliating him and stripping away his honor and sacred armor to appease the rogue. Pushed to the brink of despair by the family he once loved, Caine faces a turning point at his Ascension Ceremony. Will the powerful warrior continue to endure their cruel betrayal, or will he sever their fated bonds to claim a greater destiny?
- [I Spoke Baby Dragon and Won Everyone Over!](https://swoonflicks.com/i-spoke-baby-dragon-and-won-everyone-over/): Pediatric nurse Ava is transported to a dragon kingdom, where she can hear baby dragons’ thoughts. Using modern nursing skills, she saves troubled prince Knox from hidden injuries, allergies, and a deadly choking crisis, wins the Dragon King’s trust, defeats an old-guard rival, and rises from maid to the royal family’s top dragon nanny.
- [My Voice Saves My Family](https://swoonflicks.com/my-voice-saves-my-family/): Reborn as a baby in the wealthy Langford family, Ellie realizes her family is fated to die after being drained of luck by evil adopted daughter Cindy. Fortunately, her dad and brothers can hear her thoughts! With Ellie's inner voice warnings, the family dodges crises, exposes Cindy's plot, saves their legacy, and spoils Ellie rotten!
- [Don't touch the legendary lawyer's grandson](https://swoonflicks.com/don-t-touch-the-legendary-lawyer-s-grandson/): Lawyer Eleanor flies with her sick grandson to surgery. Oversold flight: influencer Bella steals his seat, flashing her boyfriend's platinum card, unaware she's bullying his mother, the Queen of Lawyers. Crew gag the child, lock him in a lavatory; the purser keeps the key as she begs on her knees. One films it. Off the plane, she vows they pay.
- [The Little Jinx is a Lucky Star](https://swoonflicks.com/the-little-jinx-is-a-lucky-star/): Cast out as a jinx, five-year-old Mia is seen as a miracle by the elite Murphys. Her presence heals ...
- [She Dumped a CEO for Her Sugar Baby](https://swoonflicks.com/she-dumped-a-ceo-for-her-sugar-baby/): Betrayed husband Reid Cole is secretly the billionaire running wife Vanessa's family empire. She and lover Derek humiliate Reid and her parents, whose trauma kills them. Vanessa divorces Reid, marries Derek, attends her parents' funeral in a wedding dress. Reid, named heir, exposes Derek's debts and Vanessa's fake-death plot. Years later, Vanessa uses their daughter to blackmail Reid and tries murdering him — but walks into his trap. Reid finds happiness with Eva and raises the girl as his own.
- [The Driver Is a One-Man Army](https://swoonflicks.com/the-driver-is-a-one-man-army/): Elena Grant thinks her new driver is a nobody. He's actually Jonathan Walker, a legendary mercenary sent to keep her alive. With assassins closing in and a traitor inside her company, the man she can't stand may be the only one she can trust. Anyone who comes for her will have to get through him.
- [The Lost Son Returns as a Demigod](https://swoonflicks.com/the-lost-son-returns-as-a-demigod/): Lost in a sea storm, Heron is saved and raised as the demigod Heracles. Twenty years later, he returns as a Lord. Finding his poor parents tormented by cruel relatives and arrogant nobles, Heron conceals his true identity. He ultimately unleashes his divine wrath, stripping the oppressors of their status and wealth to protect his family.
- [Trails of Hope: His Journey Back Home](https://swoonflicks.com/trails-of-hope-his-journey-back-home-dubbed/): Theo Levy lost contact with his parents 20 years ago due to a car accident. Fortunately, he was adopted by the chairman of Boyd Group, who raised him into the man he is today. Now that he has finally returned to his hometown, he swears to find his biological parents with the pendant he has.
- [Return of His Majesty](https://swoonflicks.com/return-of-his-majesty-dubbed/): Before leaving his hometown, Leo Lowe makes a promise to his fiancée, Tina Leed, that once he becomes emperor, he will return to make her his empress. Years later, he successfully establishes a new dynasty and becomes the emperor of it, so he returns to the village disguised as an ordinary villager to fulfill his promise, not expecting to be forced to pay just to get through the entrance.
- [Being Fired? Now I'm Out of Their League!](https://swoonflicks.com/being-fired-now-i-m-out-of-their-league/): Forced into an engagement with Serena, Julian follows his grandpa's order and works at Harper Enterprise for six months, secretly making Serena the new business queen of Wall Street. But Serena and her assistant Damian drive him out, and the company collapses without his protection.
- [Footprints of Fate: Tracing the Path Home](https://swoonflicks.com/footprints-of-fate-tracing-the-path-home-dubbed/): In a car accident, Kaleb Carter loses his memory due to injury. Thirteen years pass, and he is now working at Lacoy Group with his adopted daughter, Stella Carter. However, he offends William Lacoy and is bullied and humiliated. By coincidental circumstances, William discovers that Kaleb owns a lucky charm identical to the one his mother has. It turns out that Kaleb is the father William has been searching for, with 'Brandon Lacoy' being his real name.
- [Dragons Bow To The Trash](https://swoonflicks.com/dragons-bow-to-the-trash/): Born without a Dragon Mark, Elias is mocked as a powerless nobody at the Royal Dragon Rider Academy. No one knows he once routed a Level 72 Demon King, commands dragons without a bond, and has awakened Alexstrasza, the ancient King of Dragons. As corrupt nobles rig the trials against him, the academy is about to learn who the real monster is.
- [My Sister’s Boyfriend Arrested Me](https://swoonflicks.com/my-sister-s-boyfriend-arrested-me/): Retired Navy Admiral Arthur quietly returns home to see his governor sister Eleanor, but on the interstate, Police Chief Gavin and his sister Vanessa brutally target him. To cover up their gang ties and hunt for ledgers, they frame Arthur, destroy his ID and mother's photo, and beat him near death. At the last moment, Eleanor arrives—about to reveal who he truly is.
- [Not Your Average Crow](https://swoonflicks.com/not-your-average-crow/): Emily believes she is a lowly crow who accidentally lands in a phoenix nest. Adopted by Queen Angelina, she keeps trying to escape before a trial exposes her. But when the Magic Mirror shatters and Hellfire dies around her, Emily learns she is the long-lost Abyssal Phoenix—and uncovers a plot threatening her new family.
- [Mech God from the Dark Side of the Moon](https://swoonflicks.com/mech-god-from-the-dark-side-of-the-moon/): Betrayed by his father and left among lunar monsters, Ethan returns with godlike power. When his family steals his victory and a city casts him out, he builds a twelve-winged mech for those who trust him. As an alien emperor threatens humanity, the discarded son turns the entire planet into a weapon.
- [300-Year Nap: My Pets Rule](https://swoonflicks.com/300-year-nap-my-pets-rule/): A beast girl wakes after 300 years. Her pets are gone. She carries a giant sword and a cracked bowl down the mountain to find them. But her clumsy little beasts are now terrifying overlords: a beast king, a phoenix ancestor, a dragon lord. She exposes their baby photos and they turn into obedient pets. But why did her master send them away? The truth is warmer than she imagined.
- [Turkey-Man](https://swoonflicks.com/turkey-man/): Orphan Kevin gains super strength, indestructible avian features and the ability to communicate with birds after eating a radioactive turkey, secretly guarding New York as Turkey-Man. Betrayed by his girlfriend Amanda, who mistakes arrogant Chad for his benefactor, Kevin faces new threats from escaped supervillains. Fueled by jealousy, Chad injects superhero serum to mutate into the brutal Rooster. After a fierce showdown, Kevin defeats Chad, upholds justice, and receives an invitation to a global hero alliance, embracing his destined heroic journey.
- [Reborn to be the Dragon King](https://swoonflicks.com/reborn-to-be-the-dragon-king/): Brenton is the trueborn heir to the Dragon Throne. When his bastard brother, Devlin, crashes a dragon into the castle, killing the King, Brenton takes the fall to protect Devlin, but Devlin arranges for a harsher sentence for Brenton, killing him with dragonfire. However, instead of dying, Brenton is sent a few months into the past. Now that Brenton knows Devlin's true nature, he resolves to take control and get revenge.
- [The Discarded Ace](https://swoonflicks.com/the-discarded-ace/): Abandoned for 18 years by his rich family, Leo trains under a reclusive gambling legend, mastering card skills. Returning to uncover the truth, he finds the Wilson family cornered by the ruthless Blackwood clan in a deadly gamble. Scorned, Leo unleashes his techniques, turns the tide with stunning stunts, and rises from outcast to family guardian and North America's God of Gamblers.
- [OMG! The Butcher Son Is the Family Savior!](https://swoonflicks.com/dubbed-omg-the-butcher-son-is-the-family-savior/): Aiden Storm comes down from the mountain to find his birth parents. He saves Zara from an attack, drawn into a feud. In Mira, he finds a connection, but his father Damon calls him worthless. When his new family is threatened, he must unleash his power. How far will he go to protect them?
- [Abandoned Pawn, Unrivaled Dragon King](https://swoonflicks.com/abandoned-pawn-unrivaled-dragon-king/): Owen — discarded heir of the Hull family, the one and only disciple of the master of the Dragon Knight Sanctum. He awakens the Ten Dragon God Marks and forges a soul-deep bond with Akura, bearer of the ancient Golden Dragon bloodline. Betrayed by his own family, stripped of his name, and tormented by the very Sanctum that should have been his home — when the buried truth finally breaks free, the outcast of old rises in the full wrath of a Dragon God and grinds every last humiliation to dust. From that moment on, the young dragonlord sets forth across the land with his dragon at his side, and the entire continent shudders as the sky itself begins to change.

## How to Cancel a ReelShort Subscription (iPhone, Android)

URL: https://swoonflicks.com/guides/cancel-reelshort-subscription/

Cancel in your phone's store, not inside the app. On iPhone: Settings, your name, Subscriptions. On Android: Google Play, Subscriptions. ReelShort's US App Store listing says the subscription lasts 7 days and renews until you cancel, so do it at least 24 hours before the next renewal.

### Cancel on iPhone or iPad

ReelShort's own App Store listing points to the same Subscriptions screen and asks you to cancel at least 24 hours before the renewal date.

1. Open Settings and tap your name.
2. Tap Subscriptions.
3. Tap the drama app's subscription.
4. Tap Cancel Subscription. If there is no cancel button, or you see an expiration message, it is already cancelled.

- [Apple: cancel a subscription](https://support.apple.com/en-us/118428)
- [ReelShort on the App Store (US)](https://apps.apple.com/us/app/reelshort-stream-drama-tv/id1636235979)

### Cancel on Android

1. Open Google Play and go to Subscriptions.
2. Select the drama app's subscription.
3. Tap Cancel subscription and follow the steps.

- [Google Play: cancel a subscription](https://support.google.com/googleplay/answer/7018481)

### Deleting the app does not cancel

Uninstalling ReelShort leaves the subscription running. Google says this directly. Cancel it in the store first, then delete the app if you want.

### Paid on the website or some other way?

If you did not pay through Apple or Google, the subscription will not appear in your phone's store. Find the receipt email: it shows who charged you, and that is where you cancel or ask for help.

### What happens after you cancel

Google says you keep access for the time you already paid for. On iPhone, an expiration date under the subscription means it will not renew. Either way, cancelling stops the next charge; it does not refund the current week.

### Cancel now, or keep one week?

Signed up for one story and already finished it? Cancel. In the middle of a binge? Keep this week, switch off renewal now, and finish before it runs out. Next time a story hooks you, buy one week again instead of leaving a subscription running in the background.

### Refunds

Refunds for App Store purchases are requested from Apple at reportaproblem.apple.com; for Google Play purchases, from Google Play. We could not verify a separate refund policy from ReelShort itself.

- [Apple: request a refund](https://support.apple.com/en-us/118223)
- [Google Play: refund policies](https://support.google.com/googleplay/answer/2479637)

### Skip the free coin pages

Searches for ReelShort are full of free coin generators and modded apps. They do not cancel anything and can grab your login. The FTC warns that pirated video apps can carry malware. Use the store steps above.

- [FTC: malware and illegal video streaming apps](https://consumer.ftc.gov/consumer-alerts/2019/05/malware-illegal-video-streaming-apps-what-know)

### Questions & Answers

Q: How do I cancel ReelShort on iPhone?
A: Open Settings, tap your name, tap Subscriptions, tap ReelShort, then Cancel Subscription. Do it at least 24 hours before the renewal date.

Q: Does deleting ReelShort cancel my subscription?
A: No. Cancel in your iPhone Settings or in Google Play under Subscriptions. Deleting the app alone keeps the payments going.

Q: How long does a ReelShort subscription last?
A: ReelShort's US App Store listing says 7 days, renewing automatically until you cancel (checked October 2026).

Q: Can I get my money back?
A: Ask Apple through reportaproblem.apple.com or Google Play through its refund page, depending on where you paid. Approval is up to them.


## Viernes en casa: un drama corto y tu bebida favorita

URL: https://swoonflicks.com/es/guides/drama-corto-y-tu-bebida/

Elige una historia, sírvete lo que te guste y regálate una hora que sea solo tuya. Mira primero los capítulos gratis. Si al final quedaste enganchada, paga una semana y apaga la renovación esa misma noche.

### Por qué un drama corto encaja en un viernes cansado

Una película pide dos horas. Una serie pide una temporada entera. Un drama vertical pide un capítulo corto a la vez, así que puedes parar cuando se acabe la copa o cuando suene el monitor del bebé.

En la app oficial ves todas las escenas y en orden. Los clips que suben en otras páginas suelen venir cortados, desordenados o desaparecen al día siguiente.

### Elige según tu ánimo y sirve tu bebida

- Con ganas de reír y suspirar: un romance con millonario, con algo espumoso o un rosado.
- Semana pesada y alguien tiene que pagar: una historia de venganza, con una cerveza bien fría.
- Para desconectar del todo: dragones, lobos y palacios, con una copa de tinto.
- Los niños todavía medio despiertos: un drama familiar, con un té o un chocolate caliente.
- Hoy no tomas alcohol: agua mineral con limón, un mocktail, lo que haya en el refri. El drama funciona igual.

### Todo listo en cinco minutos

1. Acuesta a los niños y silencia todo menos la app.
2. Elige una sola historia de la lista de abajo. Una: saltar de drama en drama es la forma más rápida de perder la noche.
3. Mira los capítulos gratis. Si no te importa qué pasa después, déjalo ahí y a dormir.
4. Si te enganchaste, compra un pase semanal o un paquete de monedas y cancela la renovación de inmediato. Conservas el tiempo que ya pagaste.

### Cuánto cuesta una semana (App Store México)

Los precios cambian según el país y con el tiempo; revisa tu tienda antes de comprar. En la App Store de México, en la fecha que aparece al final: ReelShort mostraba suscripciones semanales de $179 y $199 MXN. NetShort, VIP Semanal desde $69 hasta $399 MXN. ShortMax, Weekly Pass Pro de $199 a $399 MXN. DramaBox, membresías de $129 a $199 MXN, sin decir cuánto dura cada una. En Android el precio puede ser distinto.

- [ReelShort en la App Store (México)](https://apps.apple.com/mx/app/reelshort-miniseries-ya/id1636235979)
- [NetShort en la App Store (México)](https://apps.apple.com/mx/app/netshort-populares-series/id6504849169)
- [ShortMax en la App Store (México)](https://apps.apple.com/mx/app/shortmax-short-drama-series/id6464002625)
- [DramaBox en la App Store (México)](https://apps.apple.com/mx/app/dramabox-series-en-l%C3%ADnea/id6445905219)

¿Varios dramas en un fin de semana? Un pase semanal suele salir más barato que desbloquear capítulo por capítulo. ¿Solo terminar una historia? Con monedas puede bastar.

### Que siga siendo un gusto

Si eres menor de edad o vas a manejar después, nada de alcohol. Decide a qué hora vas a parar antes de darle play, porque cada capítulo termina en suspenso. Y eso no es casualidad.

### Cancelar la renovación en iPhone

1. Abre Configuración y toca tu nombre.
2. Toca Suscripciones.
3. Toca la suscripción de la app de dramas.
4. Toca Cancelar suscripción. Si no aparece el botón o ves un mensaje de vencimiento, ya está cancelada.

- [Apple: cancelar una suscripción](https://support.apple.com/es-mx/118428)

### Cancelar la renovación en Android

Borrar la app no cancela la suscripción. Google dice que conservas el acceso por el tiempo que ya pagaste.

1. Abre Google Play y entra en Suscripciones.
2. Elige la suscripción de la app de dramas.
3. Toca Cancelar suscripción y sigue los pasos.

- [Google Play: cancelar una suscripción](https://support.google.com/googleplay/answer/7018481?hl=es-419)

### Questions & Answers

Q: ¿Qué drama corto ver con una copa de vino?
A: Según tu ánimo: un romance con millonario si quieres algo ligero, una venganza después de una semana dura, una historia de fantasía para desconectar. Cada póster de esta página abre la historia en su app oficial.

Q: ¿Hay que pagar para terminar un drama corto?
A: Los primeros capítulos son gratis en las apps oficiales. Para terminar, ganas o compras monedas, o compras un pase semanal. Si compras el pase, cancela la renovación de inmediato y aun así conservas la semana.

Q: ¿Cuánto cuesta un pase semanal en México?
A: Depende de la app. En la App Store de México, en octubre de 2026, NetShort mostraba VIP Semanal desde $69 hasta $399 MXN y ReelShort suscripciones semanales de $179 y $199 MXN.

Q: ¿Borrar la app detiene los cobros?
A: No. Cancela en Configuración del iPhone, en Suscripciones, o en Google Play, en Suscripciones.


## DramaBox Redeem Code: What Is Real

URL: https://swoonflicks.com/guides/dramabox-redeem-code/

Search for DramaBox codes and you will find pages full of codes, generators and masked codes. Here is what we could check.

### What we could verify

As of the date below, we could not find an official DramaBox help page about redeem or gift codes. Third-party pages describe a redemption option in the app settings during promotions, but we could not confirm it from DramaBox itself.

### How to spot a fake code page

- The code is hidden behind question marks, a countdown or a "verify you are human" step.
- It promises a round number of free coins with no date and no source.
- It asks you to install another app, enter your login or complete offers.
- It links to modded or hacked versions of the app.

### If DramaBox runs a code promotion

Real promotions usually come through DramaBox's own app notices or official social accounts. Use codes only from there.

### Creators

DramaBox dramas can be promoted through affiliate networks such as DramaCPS, which does not use invitation codes. For ReelShort, see our RS Boost invite code page.

- [RS Boost invite code for creators](https://swoonflicks.com/invite/rs-boost/)

### Questions & Answers

Q: Does DramaBox have redeem codes?
A: We could not confirm it from an official DramaBox source. Only use codes DramaBox posts itself.

Q: Are DramaBox coin generators real?
A: No. Treat them as scams.

Q: Does Swoonflicks give DramaBox codes?
A: No. We do not hand out viewer codes or coins.


## ¿Dramas cortos gratis? Lo que sí es gratis y cuándo pagar

URL: https://swoonflicks.com/es/guides/dramas-cortos-gratis/

Los primeros capítulos en las apps oficiales sí son gratis, y algunas regalan monedas por entrar cada día. Las páginas que prometen la serie completa gratis suelen traer cortes, anuncios engañosos o algo peor. Si ya te enganchaste, pagar una semana y cancelar la renovación sale más barato que perder noches buscando.

### Lo que sí es gratis

En ReelShort, DramaBox, NetShort y ShortMax los primeros capítulos de cada historia no cuestan nada. ReelShort además explica cómo ganar monedas gratis entrando cada día, viendo anuncios o completando tareas, y avisa que algunas monedas gratis pueden vencer.

- [ReelShort: cómo ganar monedas gratis (en inglés)](https://www.reelshort.com/fandom/how-to-earn-free-coins-on-reelshort-01-25-3faa2218/)

### Lo que cuesta buscar gratis

- Capítulos sueltos, recortados o fuera de orden.
- Videos que desaparecen cuando reportan la cuenta, justo en la mejor parte.
- Apps modificadas y generadores de monedas que piden tus datos. La FTC de Estados Unidos advierte que las apps piratas de video pueden traer malware.

- [FTC: malware en apps ilegales de video (en inglés)](https://consumer.ftc.gov/consumer-alerts/2019/05/malware-illegal-video-streaming-apps-what-know)

### Cuánto cuesta una semana (App Store México)

Son las compras que mostraba cada ficha de la App Store de México en la fecha que aparece al final. Los precios cambian, y en Android pueden ser distintos.

- ReelShort: suscripciones semanales de $179 y $199 MXN.
- NetShort: VIP Semanal desde $69 hasta $399 MXN.
- ShortMax: Weekly Pass Pro de $199 a $399 MXN.
- DramaBox: membresías de $129 a $199 MXN; la ficha no dice cuánto dura cada una.

- [ReelShort en la App Store (México)](https://apps.apple.com/mx/app/reelshort-miniseries-ya/id1636235979)
- [NetShort en la App Store (México)](https://apps.apple.com/mx/app/netshort-populares-series/id6504849169)
- [ShortMax en la App Store (México)](https://apps.apple.com/mx/app/shortmax-short-drama-series/id6464002625)
- [DramaBox en la App Store (México)](https://apps.apple.com/mx/app/dramabox-series-en-l%C3%ADnea/id6445905219)

### El plan para una noche tranquila

1. Elige una sola historia.
2. Mira los capítulos gratis en la app oficial.
3. Si quieres saber cómo termina, paga una semana o un paquete de monedas, lo que te salga más barato para lo que vas a ver.
4. Cancela la renovación esa misma noche. Conservas el tiempo que ya pagaste.

### Cancelar en iPhone

1. Abre Configuración y toca tu nombre.
2. Toca Suscripciones.
3. Toca la suscripción de la app de dramas.
4. Toca Cancelar suscripción. Si no aparece el botón o ves un mensaje de vencimiento, ya está cancelada.

- [Apple: cancelar una suscripción](https://support.apple.com/es-mx/118428)

### Cancelar en Android

Borrar la app no cancela la suscripción. Google dice que conservas el acceso por el tiempo que ya pagaste.

1. Abre Google Play y entra en Suscripciones.
2. Elige la suscripción de la app de dramas.
3. Toca Cancelar suscripción y sigue los pasos.

- [Google Play: cancelar una suscripción](https://support.google.com/googleplay/answer/7018481?hl=es-419)

### Questions & Answers

Q: ¿Se pueden ver dramas cortos completos gratis?
A: Los primeros capítulos sí, en las apps oficiales, y algunas dan monedas gratis por entrar cada día. Para terminar una historia larga casi siempre hay que pagar algo. Las páginas que prometen todo gratis suelen traer cortes o riesgos.

Q: ¿Es seguro descargar ReelShort o DramaBox modificado?
A: No. Las apps modificadas y los generadores de monedas pueden robar tus datos o instalar malware, como advierte la FTC. Usa la app oficial de tu tienda.

Q: ¿Cuánto cuesta ReelShort por semana en México?
A: En la App Store de México, en octubre de 2026, ReelShort mostraba suscripciones semanales de $179 y $199 MXN.

Q: ¿Borrar la app cancela la suscripción?
A: No. Cancela en Configuración del iPhone, en Suscripciones, o en Google Play, en Suscripciones.

## Is ReelShort Worth Paying For? An Honest Take

URL: https://swoonflicks.com/guides/is-reelshort-worth-it/

Yes, if one drama has you hooked and you will watch a lot of it in a few days. No, if you only dip in now and then. And a weekly pass is only worth it if you remember to cancel the renewal.

### How paying works on ReelShort

You can unlock episodes with coins, or buy a subscription. ReelShort's App Store listing (Brazil store, checked on the date below) describes the subscription as weekly, valid for 7 days, renewing automatically until you cancel, and letting you watch all stories without paying per episode while it is active. It also says prices vary by region.

We could not load the US listing when we checked, so we do not quote a price here. Open the In-App Purchases list on your own store page to see what you would pay.

- [ReelShort on the App Store (Brazil)](https://apps.apple.com/BR/app/id1636235979)

### When paying makes sense

- You are hooked on one story and want the ending this weekend, not next month.
- You plan to try several dramas in a few days, which is where a weekly pass beats buying coins episode by episode.
- You are tired of check-in coins and ad breaks and would rather just watch.

### When it does not

- You watch a few minutes now and then. Free episodes and check-in coins may be enough.
- You will forget to cancel. An auto-renewing pass you forget about is the most expensive option.
- You have not finished the free episodes yet. Wait until you know you like the story.

### Before you pay

1. Watch the free episodes first.
2. Check the price in your store's In-App Purchases list, not on a blog.
3. Choose coins for one drama, a weekly pass for a binge.
4. If you buy a pass, turn off renewal right after you buy it.

- [Apple: cancel a subscription](https://support.apple.com/en-us/HT202039)
- [Google Play: cancel a subscription](https://support.google.com/googleplay/answer/7018481)

### Questions & Answers

Q: Is ReelShort free?
A: You can start series free and earn some coins through check-ins and tasks. To keep watching you unlock episodes with coins or buy a subscription.

Q: How long does a ReelShort subscription last?
A: ReelShort's App Store listing in Brazil describes it as weekly, valid for 7 days. Check the plan shown in your own app before you buy.

Q: Does the ReelShort subscription renew automatically?
A: Yes, according to its App Store listing, until you cancel at least 24 hours before the next renewal.

Q: Can I cancel and keep watching until the week ends?
A: On Google Play, yes: Google says you keep access for the time you already paid for. On iPhone, a cancelled subscription shows its end date in Settings, Subscriptions.

Q: Is ReelShort worth it compared with hunting for free uploads?
A: If you value your time and your phone's safety, usually yes for a drama you really want to finish. Free re-uploads are often incomplete and some carry malware risk.

## ReelShort vs DramaBox vs NetShort: Which Pass to Buy

URL: https://swoonflicks.com/guides/reelshort-vs-dramabox-vs-netshort/

All four work the same way: free first episodes, then coins or a weekly pass. Prices on the US App Store sit in the same range. The real difference is the stories, because each app has its own. Buy where the drama you are hooked on lives, buy one week, and cancel the renewal.

### What each app sells on the US App Store

These are the in-app purchases each App Store listing showed on the date at the bottom of this page. The App Store shows a short list, so the apps may sell other plans inside. Prices differ by country and on Android.

- ReelShort: a $19.99 subscription that its listing says lasts 7 days and renews automatically, plus one-time purchases from $4.99 to $29.99.
- NetShort: Weekly VIP from $5.99 to $29.99, plus one-time purchases at $9.99 and $19.99.
- DramaBox: memberships from $5.99 to $19.99 and special offers from $4.99 to $19.99. The listing does not say how long each membership lasts.
- ShortMax: Weekly Pass Pro at $9.99 and $19.99, plus one-time purchases from $3.49 to $24.99.

- [ReelShort on the App Store (US)](https://apps.apple.com/us/app/reelshort-stream-drama-tv/id1636235979)
- [DramaBox on the App Store (US)](https://apps.apple.com/us/app/dramabox-stream-drama-shorts/id6445905219)
- [NetShort on the App Store (US)](https://apps.apple.com/us/app/netshort-popular-dramas-tv/id6504849169)
- [ShortMax on the App Store (US)](https://apps.apple.com/us/app/shortmax-short-dramas-tv/id6464002625)

### So which one?

- Hooked on one story: buy in the app that has it. Catalogs do not overlap.
- Want variety for a weekend: look at the weekly pass in the one or two apps whose stories you like, buy one, finish, cancel.
- Just curious: buy nothing yet. Watch the free episodes in each app and see which stories pull you in.

### Coins or a pass?

Coins unlock episodes one by one and suit a single story you want to finish. A weekly pass suits a binge across several stories. ReelShort also hands out free coins for check-ins and tasks, which can cover a few episodes.

- [ReelShort: how to earn free coins](https://www.reelshort.com/fandom/how-to-earn-free-coins-on-reelshort-01-25-3faa2218/)

### How not to pay twice

The easy way to overpay is two weekly passes running at once, or one that keeps renewing long after the binge ended. Once a month, open Subscriptions on your phone and cancel anything you are not using.

### Cancel on iPhone

1. Open Settings and tap your name.
2. Tap Subscriptions.
3. Tap the drama app's subscription.
4. Tap Cancel Subscription. If there is no cancel button, or you see an expiration message, it is already cancelled.

- [Apple: cancel a subscription](https://support.apple.com/en-us/118428)

### Cancel on Android

1. Open Google Play and go to Subscriptions.
2. Select the drama app's subscription.
3. Tap Cancel subscription and follow the steps.

- [Google Play: cancel a subscription](https://support.google.com/googleplay/answer/7018481)

### Questions & Answers

Q: Is ReelShort or DramaBox better?
A: Neither wins across the board. On the US App Store they sell similar plans in a similar price range; the stories are different. Choose the app that has the drama you want to finish.

Q: Which short drama app is cheapest?
A: On the US App Store in October 2026, the lowest weekly option we saw was NetShort's $5.99 Weekly VIP, and DramaBox listed a $5.99 membership with no duration stated. The cheapest choice depends on how much you watch that week.

Q: Can I watch short dramas without paying?
A: Partly. The first episodes are free, and ReelShort gives coins for check-ins and tasks. Finishing a long story usually means paying something.

Q: Do these passes renew automatically?
A: Weekly passes and subscriptions renew until you cancel. ReelShort's App Store listing says so directly. Cancel in your phone's Subscriptions screen.

## RS Boost Rules: What Can Freeze Your Commission

URL: https://swoonflicks.com/guides/rs-boost-rules/

Most lost commissions come from breaking a rule nobody read. This is a plain summary of the RS Boost terms, with section numbers so you can check the original.

### Where you can post

Section III.2: you may share RS Boost materials and links on online media you choose, except media that is illegal where you live. The terms advise against sites aimed at minors.

### What you must not do

- Make materials that are fake, fraudulent or misleading (III.3). Promising free coins or free full series falls here.
- Change, blur or cover trademarks and copyright marks on the materials (III.3).
- Use dishonest methods such as dark patterns, fake clicks, or forced or tricked clicks (III.4).
- Crawl, deep-link to or scrape the platform (III.4). Use the links your dashboard gives you.

### What happens if you break them

Section III.5 lets RS Boost revoke your license and freeze your account together with unpaid earnings. There is no warning step written into the terms.

### Inviting other creators

Section IV.2 says that if you bring other users into the program, your CPS ratio may be raised. The terms do not say by how much.

### If you also use DramaCPS

DramaCPS has its own terms. They ban misleading promotion and incentivized traffic without written approval, and ban redirects or intermediate pages that interfere with its tracking. Break them and unpaid commission can be confiscated.

### Disclose your links (US viewers)

The FTC expects a clear disclosure close to the link, such as "paid link" or "I earn a commission if you buy through this link". A disclosure only on your home page or behind a footer link is not enough.

### Questions & Answers

Q: Can I say viewers get free coins through my link?
A: No. That is misleading under RS Boost section III.3 unless it is true for that exact offer, and DramaCPS bans incentivized traffic without approval.

Q: Can I use a link shortener?
A: Use the links the program gives you. DramaCPS bans redirects that interfere with its tracking, and RS Boost limits deep-linking.

Q: Can RS Boost freeze my earnings?
A: Yes. Section III.5 allows freezing the account and unpaid earnings when the terms are broken.

Q: This page is a summary. Is it legal advice?
A: No. Read the full terms through the links below before you rely on any point.


## Friday Night In: A Short Drama and a Drink

URL: https://swoonflicks.com/guides/short-drama-and-a-drink/

Pick one story, pour whatever you like, and take an hour that belongs to nobody else. Watch the free episodes first. If you are hooked by the end, pay once for the week and switch off renewal the same night.

### Why a short drama works on a tired Friday

A movie wants two hours. A series wants a whole season. A vertical drama asks for one short episode at a time, so you can stop when the glass is empty or the baby monitor lights up.

Watch it in the official app and you get every scene, in order. Clips reposted on random pages are often cut, out of order, or gone the next day.

### Pick by mood, then pour

- Want a laugh and a crush: a billionaire romance, with something sparkling or a rosé.
- Bad week, and someone needs to get what they deserve: a revenge story, with a cold beer.
- Brain fully off: dragons, wolves and royal palaces, with a glass of red.
- Kids still half awake: a family drama, with hot tea or cocoa.
- Not drinking tonight: sparkling water with lime, a mocktail, whatever is in the fridge. The drama works the same.

### Set it up in five minutes

1. Put the kids to bed and silence every notification except the app.
2. Choose one story from the list below. Only one: hopping between dramas is how a whole night disappears.
3. Watch the free episodes. If you do not care what happens next, stop there and go to bed.
4. If you are hooked, buy a weekly pass or a coin pack, then cancel the renewal right away. You keep the time you paid for.

### What a week costs

Prices change by country and over time, so check your own store before you buy. On the US App Store, on the date at the bottom of this page: ReelShort listed a $19.99 subscription that its listing says lasts 7 days and renews automatically. NetShort listed Weekly VIP options from $5.99 to $29.99. ShortMax listed Weekly Pass Pro at $9.99 and $19.99. DramaBox listed memberships from $5.99 to $19.99 without saying how long each one lasts.

- [ReelShort on the App Store (US)](https://apps.apple.com/us/app/reelshort-stream-drama-tv/id1636235979)
- [NetShort on the App Store (US)](https://apps.apple.com/us/app/netshort-popular-dramas-tv/id6504849169)
- [ShortMax on the App Store (US)](https://apps.apple.com/us/app/shortmax-short-dramas-tv/id6464002625)
- [DramaBox on the App Store (US)](https://apps.apple.com/us/app/dramabox-stream-drama-shorts/id6445905219)

Bingeing several dramas in one weekend? One weekly pass usually costs less than unlocking episode by episode. Finishing a single story? Coins can be enough.

### Keep it a treat

Skip the alcohol if you are under 21 or driving later. Decide when you will stop before you press play, because the next episode always ends on a cliffhanger. That part is on purpose.

### Cancel the renewal on iPhone

1. Open Settings and tap your name.
2. Tap Subscriptions.
3. Tap the drama app's subscription.
4. Tap Cancel Subscription. If there is no cancel button, or you see an expiration message, it is already cancelled.

- [Apple: cancel a subscription](https://support.apple.com/en-us/118428)

### Cancel the renewal on Android

Deleting the app does not cancel the subscription. Google says you keep access for the time you already paid for.

1. Open Google Play and go to Subscriptions.
2. Select the drama app's subscription.
3. Tap Cancel subscription and follow the steps.

- [Google Play: cancel a subscription](https://support.google.com/googleplay/answer/7018481)

### Questions & Answers

Q: What short drama should I watch with a glass of wine?
A: Go by mood: a billionaire romance for something light, a revenge story after a long week, a fantasy drama to switch off completely. Each poster on this page opens the story in its official app.

Q: Do I have to pay to finish a short drama?
A: The first episodes are free in the official apps. To finish, you earn or buy coins, or buy a weekly pass. If you buy a pass, cancel the renewal right away and you still keep the week.

Q: How much is a short drama weekly pass?
A: It depends on the app and the country. On the US App Store in October 2026, NetShort listed Weekly VIP from $5.99 to $29.99 and ShortMax listed Weekly Pass Pro at $9.99 and $19.99.

Q: Does deleting the app stop the payments?
A: No. Cancel in your iPhone Settings under Subscriptions, or in Google Play under Subscriptions.


## Short Dramas Full Episodes Free? The Real Cost

URL: https://swoonflicks.com/guides/stop-hunting-free-episodes/

Short answer: the free episodes inside the official apps are real. Pages promising the whole drama free usually are not. If one drama has you hooked, paying once for a weekend often costs less than the evenings you spend hunting for a free copy.

### What is actually free

The apps behind the dramas we share let you start each one with free episodes. ReelShort also gives coins for daily check-ins, ads and in-app tasks, and its own guide lists them. On Swoonflicks you can start any drama we share right on the page, no sign-up.

- [ReelShort: how to earn free coins](https://www.reelshort.com/fandom/how-to-earn-free-coins-on-reelshort-01-25-3faa2218/)

### Where the "full episodes free" search leads

- Re-uploads cut into pieces, with episodes missing or out of order.
- Uploads that vanish halfway through the story when the rights holder files a claim.
- Pages that hide the video behind an app install, a survey or a "verify you are human" step.
- Coin generators and modded apps that ask for your login.

### The risk nobody mentions

The US Federal Trade Commission warns that illegal streaming apps are a common way to spread malware, and that malware can reach other devices on your home network and steal bank logins or card details. A free episode is not worth your bank password.

- [FTC: malware and illegal video streaming apps](https://consumer.ftc.gov/consumer-alerts/2019/05/malware-illegal-video-streaming-apps-what-know)

### The math only you can do

Count the minutes you spent last time searching, closing pop-ups and skipping broken links. Then open your app store, look at the In-App Purchases list of the app the drama is on, and compare. Prices differ by country and change often, so check your own store instead of trusting a number on a blog, including this one.

### A better plan: pay once, binge on purpose

Pick one drama, start watching, and pay only when you know you want the ending. Buy one coin pack or one weekly pass, watch it over a weekend, and turn off renewal straight away. Our weekend plan and our pass-or-coins guide walk through it.

### Questions & Answers

Q: Can I watch short dramas full episodes for free?
A: You can start the dramas we share free in the official apps and earn some coins through check-ins and tasks. Finishing a whole drama that way takes a lot of patience. Sites promising the full drama free are usually re-uploads or scams.

Q: Are free short drama streaming sites safe?
A: Not reliably. The FTC warns that illegal streaming apps are often used to spread malware that can steal logins and card details.

Q: Do ReelShort coin generators work?
A: No. ReelShort's own guide calls third-party coin generators unofficial and risky. Never give them your login.

Q: Is it cheaper to buy coins or a weekly pass?
A: It depends on how much you will watch in the next few days and on prices in your country. Our pass-or-coins guide shows how to decide.

Q: Does Swoonflicks give free coins or unlock codes?
A: No. We share the start of dramas we like and link to the official app for the rest. Some links are affiliate links.


## Weekend Short Drama Binge Plan: Pay Once, No Regret

URL: https://swoonflicks.com/guides/weekend-short-drama-binge/

Pick one drama on Friday and start watching. Pay once on Saturday only if you want the ending, turn off renewal right away, and finish on Sunday. No hunting, no pop-ups, no surprise charge next week.

### Friday night: pick one story

Choose by trope, not by thumbnail: fake marriage, werewolf revenge, palace intrigue, a CEO who will not let go. One drama at a time keeps the weekend about the story instead of the menu.

### Start watching

Watch the opening on Swoonflicks or in the app. If you are not hooked by the time the free episodes end, drop it and pick another. You have spent nothing.

### Saturday: pay once

Hooked? Buy one coin pack if you only want this drama, or one weekly pass if you want to try a few. Check the price in your own app store, since it varies by country.

### Turn off renewal right away

A weekly pass renews until you cancel. Cancel the renewal the moment you buy. Google says you keep access for the time you already paid for, so you lose nothing by cancelling early.

- [Apple: cancel a subscription](https://support.apple.com/en-us/HT202039)
- [Google Play: cancel a subscription](https://support.google.com/googleplay/answer/7018481)

### Sunday: finish and move on

Watch the ending, then follow us for the next pick. No lingering subscription, no tabs full of broken free links.

### Questions & Answers

Q: What is a good short drama to binge this weekend?
A: If you like romance, start with My Billionaire Boss Won't Let Me Quit or Rejected Luna Is the Alpha Queen. For palace drama, try The Empress's Final Wish.

Q: Should I buy coins or a weekly pass for a weekend binge?
A: Coins if you only want one drama, a weekly pass if you want to try several. Compare both in your app store before buying.

Q: How do I avoid being charged again next week?
A: Cancel the renewal right after you buy. On Google Play you keep access until the paid period ends. On iPhone, go to Settings, your name, Subscriptions.

Q: Can I watch vertical dramas on a laptop?
A: Swoonflicks pages work in any browser. The full series continues in the official app.


## Short Drama Weekly Pass vs Coins: Which to Buy

URL: https://swoonflicks.com/guides/weekly-pass-vs-coins/

Coins suit one drama you want to finish. A weekly pass suits a binge across several dramas in a few days. A pass renews automatically, so cancel the renewal as soon as you buy.

### How coins work

You buy a coin pack and spend coins to unlock episodes one by one. Some coins are free: ReelShort lists daily check-ins, ads and in-app tasks. ReelShort also says free coins can expire, so check your wallet.

- [ReelShort: how to earn free coins](https://www.reelshort.com/fandom/how-to-earn-free-coins-on-reelshort-01-25-3faa2218/)

### How a weekly pass works

A weekly pass, often called VIP, unlocks episodes for a week and renews until you cancel. On the US App Store, NetShort lists several Weekly VIP options from $5.99 to $29.99 (checked on the date below). ReelShort's Brazil App Store listing describes its subscription as valid for 7 days and renewing automatically. Prices vary by country, so check your own store.

- [NetShort on the App Store (US)](https://apps.apple.com/us/app/netshort/id6504849169)
- [ReelShort on the App Store (Brazil)](https://apps.apple.com/BR/app/id1636235979)

### Quick rule

- One drama, a few episodes left: coins.
- Several dramas this weekend: weekly pass.
- Not hooked yet: neither. Finish the free episodes first.

### Cancel on iPhone

1. Open Settings and tap your name.
2. Tap Subscriptions.
3. Tap the drama app's subscription.
4. Tap Cancel Subscription. If there is no cancel button, it is already cancelled.

- [Apple: cancel a subscription](https://support.apple.com/en-us/HT202039)

### Cancel on Android

Deleting the app does not cancel the subscription. Google says you keep access for the time you already paid for.

1. Open Google Play and go to Subscriptions.
2. Select the drama app's subscription.
3. Tap Cancel subscription and follow the steps.

- [Google Play: cancel a subscription](https://support.google.com/googleplay/answer/7018481)

### Questions & Answers

Q: Is a weekly pass cheaper than coins?
A: For a binge across several dramas, usually yes; for a few episodes of one drama, coins can cost less. Compare both prices in your own app store.

Q: How much is a short drama weekly VIP pass?
A: It varies by app and country. On the US App Store, NetShort lists Weekly VIP options from $5.99 to $29.99 (checked October 2026).

Q: Does deleting the app cancel my subscription?
A: No. Google says uninstalling does not cancel. Cancel in Google Play or in your iPhone's Settings.

Q: Do free coins expire?
A: ReelShort says free coins sometimes can expire. Check the terms of each bonus in your wallet.
